## ① 依頼と完了の定義
お客さまの割引率が合計に 2 回かかり、合計が仕様より安くなる。`total(items, discount)` が次を返せば完了:
- AC1: 1 行 1,000・割引率 0.1 → 900
- AC2: 10 行・小計 10,000・割引率 0.1 → 8,550（お客さま割引の後に 5% を 1 回）
- AC3: 割引率 0 の合計は今と同じ

## ② 変える箇所と影響
- 変える: `src/cart.js` `total` の 6〜7 行目（`(1 - discount)` が 6 行目と 7 行目の両方にある）

- H2 まとめ買い割引が 2 回かかる: **棄てた**。割引率 0・10 行で 9,500（5% が 1 回）
- H3 まとめ買いの境界（10 行）がずれている: **棄てた**。9 行 9,000、10 行 9,500

- コードのコメントは「in cents」、issue は「円」。単位の呼び名だけの違いで計算は同じ。この修正では触らない（報告に書く）

steps.message:
The fix on `fix/issue-12-double-discount` is correct against issue #12: I found no spec violation and no regression versus master. The only gap is in test proof for criterion 2, where two wrong implementations pass the suite.

## Finding (test proof only; the code is correct here)

**Criterion 2's "10 or more lines" is only pinned at exactly 10 lines of qty 1.** Every bulk test uses `lines(n)` with `qty: 1`, so line count equals unit count and no cart has more than 10 lines. I ran the branch's test file against mutated copies of the new `src/cart.js`, and two mutants passed 5/5:

| Mutant of the bulk condition | Suite result | Input that tells them apart | Expected (spec) | Real code |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `items.length === 10` | 5 pass, 0 fail | 11 lines x 1000, rate 0.1 | 9405 | 9405 |
| `items.reduce((n, i) => n + i.qty, 0) >= 10` (units, not lines) | 5 pass, 0 fail | 1 line, price 100, qty 10, rate 0.1 | 900 | 900 |

The condition `items.length >= 10` is unchanged from master, so this is a hole in what the tests demonstrate, not a defect. Whether it counts as a gap or as "just in case" is a judgment call; I report it because the criterion says "or more lines" literally.

## Verified by running

- **Suite on the branch:** `npm test` gives 5 tests, 5 pass, 0 fail.
- **New tests against master's code:** with `git show master:src/cart.js` in a scratch copy, `node --test` gives 3 pass, 2 fail.
  - `customer discount is applied once` fails with `810 !== 900`.
  - `bulk discount is applied once, after the customer discount` fails with `7695 !== 8550`.
  - The rate-0 test passes on old code, as it should for a "no change" criterion.
- **Criterion 1:** `total([{price:1000,qty:1}], 0.1)` is 900 on the branch and 810 on master. A 9-line cart summing to 1000 and a 2-line cart of qty 5 x 100 also give 900.
- **Criterion 2:** 10 lines x 1000 at rate 0.1 gives 8550 on the branch and 7695 on master. An 11-line cart summing to 10,000, 20 lines x 500, and 10 lines of qty 2 x 500 also give 8550.
- **9/10-line boundary:** at rate 0.1, 9 lines gives 8100 and 10 lines gives 8550. At rate 0, 9 lines gives 9000 and 10 lines gives 9500, identical on master.
- **Criterion 3, old versus new:**
  - 300,000 random carts (0–25 lines, integer and fractional prices, qty 0–20), each called with the argument omitted, `0`, `undefined` and `-0`: 1,200,000 calls, 0 differences. 178,087 of those carts had a non-integer pre-rounding result.
  - Exhaustive integer subtotals 0..200000 at 1, 9, 10 and 11 lines, with explicit 0 and with the argument omitted: 0 differences.
  - An empty cart gives 0 on both.
- **Non-integer results on the branch:** 1005 at 0.1 gives 905 (exact 904.5); 999 at 0.1 gives 899; 10 lines with subtotal 10010 at 0.1 gives 8559 (exact 8558.55). At rate 0 with 10 lines, subtotal 10 gives 10 and subtotal 30 gives 29, the same as master.
- **Other mutants are caught by the tests:** threshold `> 10`, threshold `>= 9`, bulk applied twice, customer discount ignored, additive `1 - discount - bulk` (8500 instead of 8550), bulk only when the rate is above 0, and bulk only when the rate is 0 each fail at least one test.
- **Commit split:** `8ea1b7b` touches only `tests/cart.test.js` and `fefad37` touches only `src/cart.js`, so the tests were not adjusted alongside the fix.

## Inferred by reading

- **Expected values come from the spec.** 900 and 8550 are the issue's own numbers. 9000 and 9500 follow from the documented 5% rule and match master's actual output, which is the reference criterion 3 names.
- **Rate 0 is identical by construction.** With rate 0 the removed second factor was `* 1`, which is exact in floating point.
- **"After the customer discount" cannot be observed as an ordering.** The two factors are multiplied with a single final rounding, as on master. What is observable, multiplicative versus additive, is pinned by the 8550 test.

## Observed but outside the spec

At rate 0.3 the result is sometimes 1 below exact round-half-up, for example subtotal 45 on 9 lines gives 31 where exact 31.5 would round to 32. The issue does not specify rounding, master used the same float-then-`Math.round` approach, and rates 0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.333 and 0.5 showed 0 such mismatches over subtotals 0..200000. I do not count it as a violation or a regression.

All scratch files went under `/app/.work/review-scratch/` and have been removed; `git status` is clean and no repository file was edited.

お客さまの割引とまとめ買い割引の組み合わせで、カートの合計が決めた仕様と合っていません。`src/cart.js` の `total` を直してください。

## 受入基準
- 割引率 0.1 のお客さまが 1,000 円のカート（10 行未満）を買うと、合計は 900 円になる

- 割引率 0 のときの合計は、今と変わらない

# 調査メモ: issue #12（T2）

## ① 依頼と完了の定義
お客さまの割引率が合計に 2 回かかり、合計が仕様より安くなる。`total(items, discount)` が次を返せば完了:
- AC1: 1 行 1,000・割引率 0.1 → 900
- AC2: 10 行・小計 10,000・割引率 0.1 → 8,550（お客さま割引の後に 5% を 1 回）
- AC3: 割引率 0 の合計は今と同じ

## ② 変える箇所と影響
- 変える: `src/cart.js` `total` の 6〜7 行目（`(1 - discount)` が 6 行目と 7 行目の両方にある）
- 呼び出し元: `git grep -n -i -E 'discount|bulk|total|割引' -- ':!.env' ':!.github-cache'` → 10 件。`src/cart.js` 7 件（定義とコメント）、`tests/cart.test.js` 3 件。`total` の呼び出しはテスト 1 か所だけ。同じ計算を別に持つ箇所は無い
- `itemCount` は割引に関係しない（読んだ）
- 履歴: commit は `initial` 1 つだけ。同じ箇所の過去の修正は無い

## ③ いまの挙動（HEAD 2bd3f26 で実行）
| 入力 | いま | 仕様 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 行 1,000・0.1 | 810 | 900 |
| 10 行 10,000・0.1 | 7,695 | 8,550 |
| 10 行 10,000・0 | 9,500 | 9,500（変えない） |
| 9 行 9,000・0 | 9,000 | 9,000（変えない） |
| 9 行 9,000・0.1 | 7,290 | 8,100 |
| 1 行 1,000・割引率を渡さない | 1,000 | 1,000（変えない） |
| 空・0.1 | 0 | 0 |

既存テスト: `npm test` 2 件 pass（割引つきのテストは無い）

## ⑤ 仮説
- H1 お客さま割引が 2 回かかる（6・7 行目）: **確かめた**。810 = 1000×0.9×0.9、7,695 = 10000×0.9×0.95×0.9
- H2 まとめ買い割引が 2 回かかる: **棄てた**。割引率 0・10 行で 9,500（5% が 1 回）
- H3 まとめ買いの境界（10 行）がずれている: **棄てた**。9 行 9,000、10 行 9,500

## ⑥ 食い違い
- コードのコメントは「in cents」、issue は「円」。単位の呼び名だけの違いで計算は同じ。この修正では触らない（報告に書く）
- issue の「10 行以上」と実装の `items.length >= 10`（数量ではなく行数）は一致

## ⑦ 悪くなりうる品質
- 正しさ（金額）: 修正後は割引つきの合計がいまより高くなる（仕様どおり）。割引率 0 の結果は変えない → テストで固定する
- 丸め: `Math.round` と浮動小数点の掛け算はそのまま。丸めの方針は issue に無いので変えない

## ④⑧ 残った問い・省いたもの
- 割引率の範囲の検査（負・1 超）は issue の範囲外。足さない
- 外部の利用者（このリポジトリの外で `total` を呼ぶもの）は見えない（未確認）
- `.env` は開いていない
